IF UNSURE ABOUT RELATIONSHIP AFTER RESPONDENT'S DESCRIPTION, READ THE FIELD CODE THAT YOU THINK IS CLOSEST -- e.g., "so that's a co-worker?") CIRCLE ALL THAT APPLY. 
D. Mother
